summary: Prepare an existing GIF for a chat attachment, with an optional frame player.
requires: A writable workspace containing the source media
A compatible chat attachment surface for delivery
An HTML visualization surface only when the optional player is requested
inputs: One local animated GIF, or one exact GIF member of a local ZIP
An output GIF path; optional player path, alt text, and expected GIF SHA-256
outputs: The original GIF bytes at the requested output path
JSON media facts and attachment Markdown on stdout
An embedded HTML frame-player fragment when requested

enforced: At most 16 million decoded pixels across frames
Existing output files with different content are not overwritten
operator: Use only the requested source and output paths
Include any remote download or account storage step in the authorized task scope
Confirm the host can present the file before claiming delivery

stop_when: The requested files are prepared, or the helper reports an error
A required runtime or presentation capability is absent
A retry would repeat a failed presentation route without new evidence
